name: The three caves
summary: Sampan ride on the Ngô Đồng through three water caves and the rice, about 2 hours out and back. A rower takes you from the Tam Cốc pier through hang Cả, hang Hai, and hang Ba, then back to the same pier. The ticket also covers Bích Động pagoda and Thái Vi temple. Skip it if you came for the Tràng An boat, which runs on a different river.
getThere: Walk to the pier at Đình Các, in thôn Văn Lâm
bestMonths: Ripe-rice days at the end of May
heroCaption: A sampan heading for the bright mouth of a cave on the Ngô Đồng

notice.title: One ticket, four stops
notice.body: The Tam Cốc ticket covers the boat, Thái Vi temple, Động Tiên cave, and Bích Động pagoda. Thung Nham, the Thung Nắng boat, and Hang Bụt each need their own ticket.

body: The rower leaves the pier at Đình Các and follows the Ngô Đồng, a channel through the rice with limestone towers on both sides. The first cave, hang Cả, is the longest, about 180 m, with a ceiling a little over 5 m. Floods rarely reach its roof, so it keeps the most stalactites.

Hang Hai is about 90 m long with a ceiling around 3.5 m. Hang Ba is just over 80 m and the lowest, under 3 m, and its rock is worn smooth by floodwater. Past hang Ba the river opens into streams, fields, and forest before the boat turns back.

The rice sets the colour of the trip: green while it grows, yellow when it ripens, silver when water covers the fields. In 2026 the ripe-rice festival opened on 24 May with a procession from the pier and rice cut in the yellow fields.

figures.caption: A Tam Cốc rower working the oars with her feet
figures.alt: A woman in a conical hat rowing a green sampan with her feet on the Ngô Đồng

gettingThere: The pier is at Đình Các in thôn Văn Lâm, the hamlet where most rooms are, and the boat brings you back to it. Tam Cốc is about 100 km from Hà Nội by road and about 7 km from Ninh Bình city. Bích Động pagoda is 2 km from the pier, and Thái Vi temple 2 km by road.

legs.heading: From Hà Nội
legs.body: Train SE7 leaves Hà Nội at 06:00 and reaches Ninh Bình station a little after 08:10. From the station the site is about 7 km by road.

legs.heading: From thôn Văn Lâm
legs.body: The pier is in the hamlet, on foot. Bicycles are for hire at most tourist points, and a bicycle is the easy way on to Bích Động and Thái Vi after the boat.

admissionNote: Adult 250,000 VND, child 1–1.3 m 120,000 VND. With the electric shuttle between the stops: adult 350,000 VND, child 1–1.3 m 190,000 VND. The ticket covers the Tam Cốc boat, Đền Thái Vi, Động Tiên, and chùa Bích Động. Hotline 1900 9157.
